card.name: Sentence-opening words before a recommendation
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence after a finding or dose statement, such as Until, Before, Based (on) or Starting, where an instruction or condition comes next. Also fires on 'applicable' in 'not applicable'.

modes.label: Until / Before openers
modes.description: A sentence starts with Until or Before after a safety finding, setting up a precaution.
modes.example: <<Until>> further data are obtained, combined therapy of

modes.label: Based on / Starting
modes.description: A sentence starts with Based on or Starting after a dosing statement, leading into an adjustment.
modes.example: Based<< on>> individual patient therapeutic response and tolerability,

modes.label: Not applicable
modes.description: The word applicable in a discount or exclusion notice.
modes.example: *Discount not<< applicable>> on SES Online products.

card.writes: It pushes toward directive wording such as must or label, and away from hedges like may and 可能.
card.plain: It marks the start of a sentence that is about to give a condition or instruction, not a hedge.
